# PU Sandwich Panel

> Leading Chinese manufacturer of polyurethane and composite sandwich panels for industrial and commercial building applications.

Henan Canglong Steel Structure Engineering Co., Ltd. specializes in producing high-performance insulated sandwich panels with various core materials including polyurethane (PU), rockwool, EPS, and PIR foam. The company exports globally and maintains certifications for fire-resistant and thermal insulation products.

## Key Topics

- Polyurethane (PU) Sandwich Panels
- Rockwool Composite Panels
- Thermal Insulation
- Fire-Resistant Panels
- PU Roof Panels
- PU Wall Panels
- EPS Insulation
- PIR Foam Core
- Cold Storage Panels
- International Shipping
- Henan Canglong Group
- Building Materials
- Metal-Faced Panels
- Insulated Sandwich Panel Systems
- Manufacturing Certifications

## Product Catalog

- [Products](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products): Main product catalog featuring rockwool, PUF, EPS, and glass wool panels
- [Polyurethane Sandwich Panel](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/polyurethane-sandwich-panel): Polyurethane rigid foam sandwich panels for roofs and walls
- [PU Wall Panel](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/pu-wall-panel): PU wall panel with thermal insulation and fire resistance properties
- [PU Roof Panel](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/pu-roof-panel): Polyurethane roof panel system for building applications
- [Wall Panels](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/wall-panels): Wall insulation sandwich panels including PUF, EPS, and rockwool options
- [Roof Panels](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/roof-panels): Roof sandwich panels with polyurethane, rockwool, and EPS insulation
- [Insulated Panels](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/insulated-panels): Composite insulated sandwich panels with foam and PIR insulation options
- [Insulated Sandwich Panel](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/insulated-sandwich-panel): Metal-faced insulated sandwich panels for walls, roofs, cold storage
- [Fire Rated Panels](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/fire-rated-panels): Fire-resistant rockwool and glass wool sandwich panel products
- [Cold Room Panel](https://www.pusandwichpanel.com/products/cold-room-panel): Cold storage insulation panels with PUR and PIR foam cores
